name: Takane Hibiki
source: A student in Class 3-B who's [url=/c3228]Mei's[/url] childhood friend and next-door neighbor. She is also skilled at kendo, the kendo club's president and a regular at national tournaments. Due to her cool appearance, combined with the aforementioned fact, she is quite popular with the girls. Unlike what her appearance suggests, Hibiki loves reading romance novels.
